comparison_policy.quality: all mandatory criteria and independent reviews, every task

confirmation.basis: repeated quality gain OR complete token advantage without correction regression

comparison.limitations: One suite trial is provisional. Unknown usage is not zero. Correction counts cover registered independent revisions, not inferred per-edit self-check cycles. Time is diagnostic, not a substitute for tokens.
